questions.prompt: Black Friday's here — the deals went live this morning and the whole feed is one long checkout line. Tonight, where are you in the hunt?

options.text: Still hunting — one more deal, one more tab, the night's not over yet.
Locked in — the big one is bought, the rest is just browsing.
Drowning in tabs — every deal changes the plan and I can't pick.
Done hunting — the couch won, the deals can wait till next year.

questions.prompt: Vice City's got a dress code now — the community's sharing their GTA 6 fits, and everyone's picking a look for the new world. Tonight, how are you stepping in?

options.text: Showing it off — the fit's the whole point, look at this.
Going bold — loud colors, big energy, Vice City can handle it.
Keeping it classic — my usual look, it works everywhere.
Still deciding — too many combos, my head's spinning through outfits.

questions.prompt: The parade's tomorrow morning now — 8:30am, Saturday, balloons and all — after a Thanksgiving that already moved it once. Tonight, what do you do with a morning that's suddenly on the calendar?

options.text: Early night, alarm set — the balloons are back tomorrow and I'm there for it.
Sleeping in — the parade will be all over my feed by lunch.
Making it a watch party — Saturday morning, everyone over, parade on.
Wait, it's tomorrow? — I hadn't planned for a parade morning at all.

questions.prompt: Thanksgiving was yesterday — the feast happened, and tonight the leftovers are the whole table. If someone handled the table tonight, what would you want on it?

options.text: The full second plate — turkey, stuffing, all of it, round two.
Sandwiches for the crew — stacked high, eaten standing in the kitchen.
Something light and warm — a quiet bowl of soup, the feast can rest.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: On Thanksgiving Eve, U2 took the halftime stage to honor Dolly Parton — a tribute, under the lights, with the whole night watching. Tonight, which sound of that moment is yours?

options.text: The big anthem moment — turned all the way up, the whole stadium singing.
The singalong — everyone joining in on the chorus, all at once.
The quiet stripped-back verse — soft, warm, the one that lands.
None of it tonight — my own quiet, the tribute can wait.

questions.prompt: South Park just wrapped its season — the finale's out, the ending's landed, and the show's done for now. In the hour ahead, what does the aftertaste feel like?

options.text: Diving into the discourse — reviews, reactions, what it all meant.
Texting the group — did you see that ending? We need to talk.
Letting it settle — something gentle next, the night slows down.
Screens off — the finale's done, and so am I for tonight.
